models.name: Bonsai 2 27B
models.why: PrismML's Ternary Bonsai 2 27B at 1.72 bits per weight (PTQ1_0 is 5.95 GB) runs on Apple Silicon from a 16GB M1 Pro MacBook to an M4 Max Mac Studio, with an iPhone-class context window of 262K in the smallest packing.

engines.hardware: Mac Studio M4 Max, 128GB unified memory
engines.quant: ternary (~1.72 bits per weight); prose 34.5 / code 34.3 tok/s, 242 tok/s prefill

engines.hardware: Mac mini M4, 24GB unified memory, 10-core GPU
engines.quant: ternary (~1.72 bits per weight); 11.0 tok/s decode, 33 tok/s prefill

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B
models.why: At a 262K context window the 27B class is a bandwidth problem on a Mac: the same ternary-compressed weights give 34.5 tok/s on an M4 Max Studio and 11 tok/s on a 24GB Mac mini, a 3.1x decode gap that tracks memory bandwidth.

engines.hardware: Mac Studio M4 Max, 128GB unified memory
engines.quant: ternary 1.72-bit compression of Qwen3.8-27B; prose workload, 262K context capacity
